fact: The driver failed to follow the Race Directors Instructions at Turns 4 and 5
offence: Breach of Article 12.2.1.i of the International Sporting Code and non-compliance with Race Director's Event Note (item 25.2, document 5).
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence. The driver did not follow the prescribed path when he went off track at Turns 4 and 5.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Failure To Follow Race Directors Instructions
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams F1 Team
